en.firstUseTitle: Your Work Card belongs to you.
en.firstUseBody: Nexus checks for supported work applications on this device only. Your installed-app list is not sent to or stored on Nexus servers. Nothing is connected, published or shared with an employer, agency or another person without your clear approval. You choose what to share, with whom and for how long. You can withdraw access at any time.
en.persistentLabel: Private by default. Shared only by you.
en.addPromptTemplate: {appName} was found on this device. Add it to your Work Card?
